howToApply: Visit Bank’s official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in under Career section → Current Opportunities.
Register online in the appropriate Online Application Format available through the link on the Careers → Current Opportunities page.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, bio-data, and other required documents as per specifications.
Carefully fill in all details in the online application form. No changes are permitted after clicking SUBMIT.
Pay the application fee online using Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.
On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated — print and retain for future reference.

howToApply: Visit the official website www.neepco.co.in and navigate to the Careers section.

Candidates already working in Government/Public Sector Enterprises must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of written test.

shortInfo: ONGC has announced notification for Medical Officer – Occupational Health, Specialist for Dehradun Hospital, Specialist for Sivasagar Hospital, Medical Officer – Homeopathy posts. Required qualification: MBBS, MD, MS, DNB, PG Diploma, BHMS. Last date to apply: 18-08-26.

howToApply: Visit the official ONGC website at www.ongcindia.com to register on the registration web link.
Registration window is open from 05.08.2026 to 18.08.2026 (23:59 hours).
Candidates can apply for only ONE post-location combination based on their eligibility and interest. In case of multiple applications, only the latest application shall be considered.

Upload the required documents: recent passport size color photograph with signature, photo identity proof (PAN Card, Aadhar, Passport, Driving License, Voter ID), Class 10th Board Certificate (DOB proof), consolidated marksheet of MBBS/BHMS degree, MBBS/BHMS degree certificate, PG degree/diploma marksheets and certificates, DNB certificate (if applicable), training certificate in occupational health/public health/occupational medicine (if applicable), and proof of higher qualification (if any).
Candidates will be informed about the interview (date, time, venue) through email.
Document Verification and Interview will be conducted in-person (physical mode) at the specific work location/venue for which the candidate has applied.
No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
